title: test: update community relisting fixture
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Advances the hidden timestamp past the 12-hour relisting delay
- Keeps the existing account API relisting assertion meaningful
- Fixes the Gen suite failure introduced by the new relisting policy

gist.headline: The clock blooms again
gist.blurb: A test account waited out the full 12-hour relisting nap. The Gen suite can once again confirm that hidden communities return exactly when the policy says they should.
gist.summary: Updated the Gen community endpoint fixture to advance its hidden timestamp beyond the 12-hour relisting delay, preserving the account API relisting assertion under the new policy.
gist.impact: Developers get a reliable regression check that communities become eligible for relisting after the configured 12-hour window.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy garden clock marks twelve hours while Polli, wearing tiny watchmaker glasses, tends a code-flower emerging from a hidden planter; this represents the test fixture advancing past the relisting window. A small CRT monitor robot can hold a passing-test printout, with lime-green terminal glow and surrounding flowers.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink blush and light blue wings, wearing tiny watchmaker glasses as she adjusts a garden clock at twelve hours beside a code-flower sprouting from a once-hidden planter; a happy CRT monitor robot holds a small pixel printout reading "TEST OK". Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, subtle flowers and vines, nostalgic but beautiful.
